title: Attack matching ignores energy cost/HP/color
body: Attack-path candidate matching only uses attack name fuzzy match. Does not filter by energy cost, HP, or Pokemon type/color, leading to overly broad candidate sets.

title: OCR fails on slightly blurry images
body: RapidOCR produces garbage on slightly blurry card photos. Misty page (014711) had 6 failures all from photography quality. Removed from eval rather than solved.

title: Color detector confused by orange binder
body: Card color/type detection picks up the orange binder background color, confusing the type classifier.

title: Stamp classifier broken (inverted results, disabled)
body: The stamp/holo classifier was producing inverted results. Currently disabled rather than fixed.

title: Buffer Piece wrong set (DINOv2 cannot distinguish similar art)
body: DINOv2 embedding matching picks the wrong set printing for Buffer Piece because multiple printings have nearly identical art. Visual similarity fails when the difference is only the set symbol.

title: Contour expansion insufficient for edge cards
body: Uniform 4% expansion from centroid only pushes y=81 to 57. Edge cards need asymmetric: 14% for corners near image edges, 4% for interior.

title: PRERELEASE stamp text matches attacks
body: OCR reads PRERELEASE stamp as PRENELEMEE which fuzzy-matches peerless edge at 0.636. Fixed by raising threshold from 0.60 to 0.70.

title: Empty string matches everything in name lookup
body: _lookup_name returns empty string for unknown IDs. Python empty-string-in-string is always True, causing false matches. Fixed with guard clause.

title: Eval: 98.1% (106/108)
body: Name path: 105/105 (100%). Attack path: 5/5 (100%). DINOv2 global: 0/1 (0%). Blurry Misty page removed from eval.

title: Methods confirmed useless
body: DINOv2 global search (15%), CLIP name matching (19%), perceptual hashing (0%), template matching (0%), set symbol matching (regresses accuracy), card number OCR (text too small).

title: Eval: 99.0% (95/96)
body: 95/96 adjusted accuracy. Raw 95/99. 3 empty-slot mismatches in GT (not real failures). Speed: 0.3-0.6s per card, 2.4-5.6s per page. Fully within 10s/page budget.
failures: Dark Electrode (Japanese kanji - JP OCR agent in progress)

title: Misty's Horsea no longer misidentified as Voltorb
body: Attack matching could override valid name OCR with wrong species when attacks were generic (Tackle). Added -0.30 penalty when attack result disagrees with valid name OCR (conf>=0.70).

title: Card number OCR gated to opt-in (was breaking 10s/page budget)
body: Buffer Piece fix added 12-attempt card number OCR to every card. For 9-card binder pages this added ~30s of OCR per page. Made it opt-in via enable_card_number_ocr=False (default).

title: Color detector binder bleed-through fixed
body: Inset border sampling regions 4% from edge, broadened orange filter (S>=100, V>=130), fixed Psychic threshold for desaturated binder photos. 64.7% -> 76.5% on test cards.

title: Attack energy/HP scoring as disambiguator
body: Added soft scoring: +0.08 for matching energy type, -0.05 for mismatch, -0.10 for HP mismatch. Fixes Cradily vs Gliscor (same Tackle attack, different types).

title: Stamp OCR set-name fuzzy matching + page scan dict bug
body: Added EX_STAMP_NAMES dict (ex7-ex16) and rapidfuzz partial_ratio against OCR text. Also fixed bug where stamp OCR was checking precomputed[i] instead of result dict for page scans.

title: Buffer Piece wrong set tiebreaker
body: Card number + set total now used as scoring bonuses (+0.08 / +0.15) when DINOv2 scores are tied across sets with same artwork. Only runs when enable_card_number_ocr=True.

title: Corrupted Mightyena image re-segmented
body: card_05.png in page_20260320_223702 was truncated (163KB vs ~2MB). Re-ran segmenter on original page photo, replaced corrupt file. Eval now passes 9/9.

title: Refactoring complete: scripts/, ml/, data/, root
body: Scripts: 170 .py files into 14 subdirs. ML: 24 dead modules to _archive/. Data: 10 dead dirs removed. Root: 35+ junk files deleted. Path refs in 22 files updated.

title: New tracking systems live
body: cardprice/scan_logger.py (CSV with per-card ledger), cardprice/devlog.py (JSONL), /scan-stats and /card-ledger endpoints in server.py. Scan logger hooked into _handle_scan_page().

title: check_ex_stamp_fast false positive on Pidgeot ex13-14 (Holon Phantoms)
body: Foil glare on bottom-right of Delta Species cards in binder sleeves drops stamp_sim by ~0.21 without an actual stamp overlay. Old threshold (0.09) caught it as stamped. Real stamps showed diff=0.24-0.40 with stamp_sim=0.15-0.43; Pidgeot showed diff=0.21 with stamp_sim=0.53.

title: Stamp detection: bumped threshold + stamp_sim ceiling
body: Threshold 0.09 -> 0.22 and added stamp_sim < 0.50 requirement. Verified on user binder scan: 6/6 correct (Pidgeot rejected, Nidoran/Tropius/Nidoqueen still pass with conf 0.76-0.99).

title: Metagross stamped Delta Species name OCR fails
body: Foiled artwork on stamped EX Delta Species cards (e.g. Metagross ex13-11) defeats RapidOCR name reading. Pipeline falls through to attack OCR which matches generic attacks like Crush and Burn -> wrong card (e.g. Hoopa EX xy7-28). Need: (a) artwork-only DINOv2 fallback when name OCR returns None, (b) read DELTA SPECIES marker text and bias candidates.

title: Wrong Metang variant picked among delta species printings
body: Multiple Metangs in DB; DINOv2 picks wrong one. The δ DELTA SPECIES marker text should narrow candidates but is not currently extracted from the card subtype line.

title: Stamp false positive on Pidgeot ex13-14 fixed (binder scan)
body: Threshold 0.09->0.22 + added stamp_sim<0.50 ceiling. Foil glare on bottom-right of unstamped Delta Species cards was producing diff~0.21 without an overlay. Tested on 6 cards from user binder: 6/6 correct, no real stamps lost.

title: Always run attack OCR in batch mode (was skipping for high-conf names)
body: Batch identify_page_v2 used to skip attack OCR when name conf >= 0.85 to save ~1s/page. Broke disambiguation for common Pokemon with many printings: Metang has 23 printings, OCR conf 0.98, but DINOv2 alone picked tk2a-5 (Galaxy Trainer Mat) over correct ex11-49 Metang δ. Cost of always running attack OCR: ~1s extra per page (1.0s/card vs 0.2s/card). Still well under 10s/page budget.

title: Stamp-set rescue for unreadable foiled cards (Metagross δ)
body: New step 5b: when name OCR fails AND attack DINOv2 score < 0.50 AND stamp text was OCR-matched to a known EX set (e.g. "DELTA SPECIES" -> ex11), do a DINOv2-only search constrained to that set. Recovers cards like Metagross δ where the foiled stamped artwork makes "Metagross" unreadable but the stamp text is fine. Only one Metagross δ in ex11 -> instant correct match. Previously fell through to attack OCR which matched generic attacks and picked Hoopa EX.

title: Fast EX stamp gate lowered from 0.99 to 0.70
body: check_ex_stamp_fast returns conf=0.70-0.99 based on margin above threshold. After bumping threshold to 0.22, real stamps near the threshold (e.g. Nidoran ex15-56 conf=0.76) failed the >=0.99 gate. Lowered to >=0.70 since check_ex_stamp_fast already gates internally with the new stamp_sim ceiling.

title: Eval: 100.0% (8/8)
body: User binder page 20260406_162414: 8/8 cards correct + 4/4 stamps correct (Metang δ, Metagross δ, Pidgeot not-stamped, Tropius+Nidoran+Nidoqueen stamped). 1 card back correctly detected as not-a-card. 1.0s/card. Page contains all-Delta-Species mix from EX Delta Species (ex11), Holon Phantoms (ex13), and Dragon Frontiers (ex15).

title: Card back detection (card_00 of binder pages)
body: Cards visible through the back of a sleeve in a binder page show as orange-tinted Pokemon backs. Pipeline correctly identifies these as backs (no card_id, conf 0.36, method v2_card_back). Not counted as failures in eval.
